source.title: Taichi & Agumon - Courage Duo
source.name: Taichi & Agumon
source.description: Taichi is a fifth grader with strong leadership and the drive to take action, and he holds the Crest of Courage. His partner is Agumon, an energetic Digimon.

skills.name: Gaia Force

description.raw: Agumon uses Baby Flame as his normal attack, dealing 150% (ATK-based) damage to an enemy. The first time Agumon uses his Ultimate, he Digivolves into Wargreymon, permanently increasing his HP by 100% and ATK by 50%, and unlocking new skills. When casting Ultimate as Wargreymon, he fires Gaia Force at his current target, dealing 160% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage 7 times to enemies within 3 tiles of the target area. Damage dealt to enemies at the center is increased to 220% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based). Wargreymon is unaffected while casting this skill. Passive. Taichi does not directly ioin the battle, remaining invincible on the sidelines. Everv 3s. Taichi cheers for Agumon, restoring 150 Energy for him. If Agumon has not yet Digivolved into Wargreymon, the Energy restored by this cheer is increased by 250.

skills.name: Brave Tornado

description.raw: Wargreymon spins at high speed, piercing through all enemies one by one before returning to his original position. He deals 420% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage to each enemy hit and stuns them for 2s. Wargreymon is invincible while casting this skill. Damage from this skill gains 60 extra DEF Penetration.

skills.name: Recovery Shield

description.raw: Wargreymon gains a shield equal to 700% (ATK-based) + 100% (SP-based) for 10s. While the shield is active, Wargreymon remains unaffected. When the shield expires, Wargreymon recovers HP equal to 150% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) of the remaining shield value. When Agumon Digivolves into Wargreymon, Wargreymon immediately gains the shield from this skill.

skills.name: Dramon Killer

description.raw: Wargreymon slashes the enemy 3 times, with each slash causing them to lose 140% (ATK-based) HP. If only 1 enemy remains on the battlefield and their HP is below 650% (ATK-based), Wargreymon instead dashes through the enemy and instantly defeats them.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: When a battle starts, Wargreymon shares the power of courage with allies, increasing his own ATK and the ATK of all allies positioned behind him by 25% of his ATK for 20s. If Gabumon receives the power of courage, he gains 300 extra Energy.
